title: Six Governors, 22 Mayors Join First Pacific Northwest-Wide Diwali Series
excerpt: Idaho, Nebraska, Montana, North Dakota and Washington hosted first-ever Diwali celebrations at capitols and governors' mansions, with Oregon closing the series in Salem on November 10.
body:
• Governors of Idaho, Nebraska, Montana, North Dakota and Washington hosted first-ever Diwali celebrations at their state capitol rotundas and governors' mansions this year, in partnership with the Consulate General of India in Seattle, according to ANI reporting carried by DD News.
  • Across Washington state, 22 cities held Diwali ceremonies in their city council chambers, where mayors and council members lit the ceremonial lamp, and several states and cities issued proclamations recognising Diwali.
  • The series began in mid-October and concludes on November 10 with an Oregon state-level celebration hosted by the Governor of Oregon at the State Capitol in Salem, alongside ceremonies at Seattle City Hall and the King County Council.
  • What it means for you: if you live in the Pacific Northwest, the November 10 Salem, Seattle City Hall and King County Council ceremonies are the closing public events of this first region-wide series.

The governors of Idaho, Nebraska, Montana, North Dakota and Washington hosted Diwali celebrations at their state capitol rotundas and governors' mansions this year for the first time, in a series organised in partnership with the Consulate General of India in Seattle, according to ANI. US senators, members of Congress, mayors and members of the Indian-American community attended the celebrations.

A first for five statehouses

The scale is what makes this year different. Diwali has been marked at the White House and in many city halls before, but ANI reported that this was the first time the festival was hosted at the capitol rotundas and governors' mansions of all five states in the Seattle consulate's wider region. In Washington, Governor Bob Ferguson and State Senator Manka Dhingra joined the first Diwali celebration at the State Capitol in Olympia. In a statement on X quoted by ANI, the Consulate General of India in Seattle said the rotunda in Olympia provided the setting for a celebration bringing together state leadership, the Indian-American community and friends of India, and thanked Ferguson and Dhingra for recognising the community's contributions to Washington state.

Across Washington state, the observance went well beyond the capitol. Twenty-two cities held Diwali ceremonies in their city council chambers, where mayors and council members lit the ceremonial lamp. Several states and cities also issued official proclamations recognising Diwali and the contributions of the Indian-American community, according to ANI.

One state at a time: North Dakota

The North Dakota leg shows what these evenings looked like on the ground. Diwali was celebrated for the first time at the Governor's Residence in Bismarck on October 29, bringing together Governor Kelly Armstrong, First Lady Kjersti Armstrong, State Agriculture Commissioner Doug Goehring, the Consul General and families from Bismarck, Fargo, Grand Forks and other parts of the state, The Indian EYE reported. Armstrong joined the ceremonial lighting of the diya and praised Indian-Americans' contributions in healthcare, business and community life.

"We should celebrate these relationships. We should celebrate these friendships. Diversity is our strength."

— Kelly Armstrong, Governor of North Dakota

The Bismarck programme included Indian cultural performances by young members of the community and Indian food for guests. Armstrong also pointed to trade and agriculture as areas of growing cooperation between India and North Dakota, including pulse crops such as peas and lentils.

Why it matters, and what is still to come

For the diaspora in the consulate's jurisdiction — which spans Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, North Dakota and neighbouring states — the series is formal recognition at the highest level of state government, in a region where Indian-Americans are a fast-growing part of the technology, healthcare and university workforce. The celebrations also sat alongside a national marker this season: the United States Postal Service unveiled a new Forever stamp commemorating Diwali, ANI reported, and US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor marked the festival at the US Embassy in New Delhi.

The series is not over. It concludes on November 10 with the Oregon celebration at the State Capitol in Salem, hosted by the Governor of Oregon, alongside ceremonies at Seattle City Hall and the King County Council, according to ANI. For families in the region, those are the last chances this year to attend a Diwali ceremony inside a seat of government.
